title: Machine learning in renal pathology.
summary: Image-derived biomarkers and pretrained deep-learning models were evaluated for diagnosing three named glomerular pathologies from renal-biopsy slides, with patient-level held-out testing. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: Methods apply glomerular biomarker extraction and pretrained CNNs to PAS renal-biopsy images; Results report patient-held-out classification of MCD, MN and TBMN.
